summary: Petty Cash feature tested E2E. Backend: 15/16 pytest pass (create, validation, filters, aggregates by_category/by_location, staff isolation, 403 on cross-user edit/delete, admin edit/delete any, soft delete, receipt upload + image fetch, 401 unauth). Frontend: tile in Operate navigates to /jkhive/petty-cash; add spend with receipt photo, list + total + category chips update; all presets, custom from/to, site & category filters correct; edit loads into form and saves; delete with confirm removes row; staff sees only own entries with 'Your spends' copy; mobile 390px has no horizontal overflow. No console/page errors.

minor.issue: Whitespace-only description ('   ') passes min_length=1 then is stripped and saved as empty string (200). Validate after strip (field_validator) to reject with 422.
location_id is not validated against existing locations (e.g. 'TEST_locA' accepted); staff can post to any site id.

issues: Count label not pluralised correctly: shows '1 entries' (petty-summary-count)
On first visit the pre-existing JKHive 'Pick a location' sheet overlays the page until a site is chosen - expected layout behavior, not a petty cash bug

action_items: Reject whitespace-only description on create/update (validate after strip)
Optional: validate location_id exists in locations collection
critical_code_review_comments: routes/petty_cash.py uses sync pymongo calls inside async def handlers (blocks event loop) - consistent with rest of codebase but worth noting
Backend 'managers see all' is implemented as admin/super_admin only (no separate manager role) - matches auth roles in auth.py
PettyForm useEffect depends on defaultLocationId; if locations load after the user starts typing, the form is reset to blank (edge case)
PATCH allows receipt_url to be any arbitrary string up to 300 chars (not restricted to /api/images/)
